_comment: Google Workspace test users the attribute-map integration tests rely on.
This is the reference for what must exist in the test tenant. It is checked
against the suites' expectations by lib/test_google_test_data.py.
Each user is a Directory API user resource: primaryEmail and id identify the
user; EVERY OTHER FIELD is the users.patch request body that sets that user
up (https://developers.google.com/admin-sdk/directory/reference/rest/v1/users/patch).
A patch replaces each list field it carries (organizations, phones,
addresses, relations) as a whole; fields not listed are left untouched.
Organization 'type' and phone/organization 'primary' cannot be set in the
Admin console; apply them through the API.
Data rules (enforced by the checks):
- customSchemas.SSOSync-Test.AWSUsername is a scalar and MUST be email-shaped
(ssosync also uses the Username as the synthesized primary work email) and
must differ from the user's primary email so the remap suite updates every user.
- SSOSync-Test.CostCodes is a SINGLE-VALUED custom field: one cost center per user.
- SSOSync-Test.ProjectCodes is a MULTI-VALUED custom field (define it with
'multiValued: true'). ssosync does not support multi-valued custom
attributes: the rich_map suite maps it and asserts it is warned about and
ignored. Google stores each entry as {type, value}; the type is ignored.
- SSOSync-Test.LongValue is SINGLE-VALUED, set ONLY on AceHole, and longer
than 128 characters (the SCIM userName maxLength).
- AceHole's givenName is a single space: Google requires a non-empty given
name, and ssosync treats it as blank (requiredField warning).
- No user has websites (the tenant's user schema has no websites field).
